notes: The catalog prints codes zero-padded (CJ 001, CJ 011, etc.); these were matched to closed-list codes CJ 1, CJ 11, etc. and not marked as catalog additions.

The required list includes a row '6 units from Corrections or Law Enforcement ....6'. The shared paragraph (printed in the Law Enforcement section) says the Certificate in Corrections requires the 24-unit Required Courses and 6 units from the 'respective' electives, so the 6 units were recorded as the Corrections Electives block. Reviewer may check whether Law Enforcement electives (CJ 056, CJ 064) may also count.
Required Courses block stated 24 units is taken from the shared paragraph ('24-unit Required Courses'); the table itself prints only 'Required Major Total Units 30'.

The outcomes list is printed once for the Criminal Justice, Corrections Certificate of Achievement/Associate in Science; the certificate shares it. PDF ligature glyphs (e.g., 'JusƟ ce') were read as 'ti'. The third outcome has no ending period as printed.

The page section covers both the Certificate of Achievement and the A.S.; the A.S. additionally requires General Education and electives to reach 60 units, which is not recorded here since this record is for the certificate.
No careers are named in the Corrections section.
